top_signals.title: Gold Steadies Above $4,300 as Traders Weigh Fed Rate-Hike Path
top_signals.summary: Gold recovered from an early bout of profit-taking to trade steady above $4,300 an ounce, with investors weighing the likely path of US monetary policy after tame US inflation data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: 10-year Treasury yield is little changed after weak retail sales data
top_signals.summary: The moves come after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: United Airlines cargo chief Jan Krems to retire after storied career
top_signals.summary:
United Airlines’ Cargo President Jan Krems is stepping down next month after a dozen years at the carrier and a reputation as one of the best air cargo executives of the past 40 years.

top_signals.summary: White sugar futures in London headed for a third straight weekly gain, boosting refining margins as concerns over tightening supplies stay in focus.
